Bundled, minified vendor code matching this project's stated purpose is normal.

This is a plausible match for the shady-link signal, and no network request, navigation, or outbound data flow is shown in the evidence. The matched literal values were not retained, so the signal cannot be tied to any demonstrated exfiltration or link-following behavior.
